result.description: Team messaging and collaboration platform with channels, DMs, files, workflows and apps.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 install flow yields scoped bot (xoxb), user (xoxp) tokens; app-level tokens (xapp) for Socket Mode. Token rotation optional. Single-workspace custom apps can use their installed token directly.
result.access_detail: Any developer can create an app and, after activating public distribution with an OAuth flow, install it into other workspaces as an unlisted app. No Marketplace review is required for installs; Marketplace listing is only recommended for commercial distribution. Free Slack plan exists (up to 10 apps). Caveats (not verified on fetched pages): Slack's 2025 policy throttles conversations.history/replies for commercially distributed non-Marketplace apps. The free-sandbox claim was not verified. The official MCP server is restricted to Marketplace/internal apps.
result.api_notes: Web API with about 120+ methods across chat, conversations, users, files, reactions, pins, reminders, search, views, canvases, usergroups, workflows and more. Events API and Socket Mode for events. Per-method tiered rate limits, identical across plans.
result.blocker: Official MCP server only for Marketplace-published or internal apps. Unlisted distributed apps may face reduced history rate limits (unverified on fetched pages). A Marketplace listing is advisable for commercial scale.
